# Wordfire
> Pass-and-play collaborative storytelling around a digital campfire. One contribution at a time.

- Live: https://wordfire.jonbailey.xyz/
- Original experimental host: https://wordfire.grok.me/
- Source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/wordfire
- License: see repository
- Network: Pitchfork-and-Torch / jonbailey.xyz

## One-liner
One word (or phrase) at a time — local pass-and-play or remote WebRTC circles. Stories stay on-device unless you share them.

## Modes
- Pass-and-play on one device (offline-capable PWA)
- Remote circle via room codes + peer-to-peer WebRTC
- Local archive of finished stories

## Privacy
Guest-first. No account required for local play. Remote peers may learn each others' IPs during ICE (WebRTC).
